title: Bakery website
when: The user asks for a site for a bakery, patisserie, bread shop or cake maker.
prompt:
Goal: A warm, appetizing site that answers the three questions customers have: what is baked today, when are you open, how do I order.
Steps:
1. Open with the bakery name, one line about what makes the baking special, and a button to see the menu or order.
2. List products in groups (breads, pastries, cakes) with name, a short description and the price in the local currency.
3. Show the opening hours as a list per day and the address with a tel link and a map link.
4. Add a custom order section for cakes: what to send (date, size, flavor) and how far ahead to ask.
5. Use warm neutrals with one deep accent; keep body text dark on light for contrast.
6. Add LocalBusiness style JSON-LD with name, address, phone and opening hours.
Quality bar:
- Prices and hours are easy to scan on a phone.
- Product names are real bakery items that fit the request.
- Allergens or dietary notes appear where they matter.
Pitfalls:
- Beige text on cream backgrounds that fails contrast.
- Hours hidden in the footer only.
- Images without alt text describing the item.
Verify:
- [ ] Menu groups use headings and lists.
- [ ] Opening hours list every day, closed days marked.
- [ ] Phone is a tel link.
- [ ] JSON-LD parses.
Output: index.html and style.css, optional menu section on the same page; structured data in the head.

examples.input: crie um site para minha padaria Pao da Vila
examples.output: hero "Fresh bread every morning since 1998", menu with sourdough and croissants, hours Mon to Sat, order by phone
